title: Arcane Bodyguard
summary: Arcane Bodyguard is an Arcane Enhancement that provides healing for Companion upon killing 6 enemies with melee within 30 seconds.
extract:
Arcane Bodyguard is an Arcane Enhancement that provides healing for Companion upon killing 6 enemies with melee within 30 seconds.
Can be sold for  ‍1,000.

Effect

Acquisition
Awarded from Arbitrations missions.
Can be purchased from the Arbitrations vendor in the  Arbiters of Hexis room in Relays for 10  Vitus Essence.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
 Arcane Bodyguard can heal any active Companion, including Sentinels and MOAs.
Does not revive the companion if they are incapacitated.
